# GoatConf 2027

> A free conference for people who build and sell software: engineers, designers, product people, founders, and the incurably curious dreamers and visionaries. Any programming language, any stack. An excuse to hang out with like-minded people and learn from folks sharing their current best. In Tuzla, Bosnia and Herzegovina, on 3–5 June 2027. One-hour sessions in every room of IPI Academy, long breaks in town, and a day for the community.

- Dates: Thursday 3rd and Friday 4th June 2027 are talk days; Saturday 5th June 2027 is the community day.
- Place: IPI Academy, Kulina bana 2, 75000 Tuzla, Bosnia and Herzegovina, next to Freedom Square (Trg slobode).
- Price: tickets are free. Registration asks only for a name and an email, on Luma.
- Format: one-hour talks, panels and workshops in all seven rooms of IPI Academy, with an hour off after each slot. Proposals for 30 minutes are welcome too, and may be paired into one hour. Closer to June, people with a ticket also register for the sessions they want, because each room has only so many seats; everyone with a ticket gets an email with how, and seats nobody registered for go to whoever is at the door.
- Friday starts half an hour earlier, at 09:30, and ends at 16:30.
- Saturday has no talks: it is the community's day, with the organiser's day at the Pannonian salt lakes and the goat hunt, plus events people add, such as walks and meetups.
- Talks: an open call; anyone may propose a session, first-time speakers welcome. We read every proposal.
- Supporters: companies can support GoatConf online for 500 EUR plus VAT where it applies (logo and link on the site, one social post, a mention in attendee emails; nothing at the venue), invoiced by the organiser's Austrian business, or pay a supplier directly. A host who funds and organises an accepted event is listed as a supporter too, if they agree. Speakers pay their own travel and stay; money from supporters that the event does not need goes first to refunding speakers who pay their own way, after the event, never promised.
- Recording: GoatConf aims to record the sessions in the two big halls of IPI Academy, the main hall and the first-floor hall; this is not promised yet, as it depends on the available budget. People may also bring a camera or a podcast, and a supporter may pay for a crew.

Register: https://luma.com/event/evt-dU4KbLhpIAm9Y9V
Propose a session: https://goatconf.com/talk
Contact: info@muhamed.at, or the form at https://goatconf.com/contact
Follow GoatConf: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/goatconf/, X https://x.com/goatconf

## Speakers

- [Paul Campbell](https://goatconf.com/speaker-paul-campbell): Co-founder and CEO of Tito
- [Carmine Paolino](https://goatconf.com/speaker-carmine-paolino): Creator of RubyLLM, founder of Plenty
- [Dejan Menges](https://goatconf.com/speaker-dejan-menges): Staff Engineer at Vinted, author of Enola
- [Amar Mahmutbegović](https://goatconf.com/speaker-amar-mahmutbegovic): Co-founder and Head of Engineering at Semblie
- [Cristian Planas](https://goatconf.com/speaker-cristian-planas): Author of Rails Scales!, at Combinaut
- [Christoph Lipautz](https://goatconf.com/speaker-christoph-lipautz): Senior Staff Engineer at Meister

## Supporters

- [IPI Academy](https://goatconf.com/supporter-ipi-academy): Host and partner: the rooms at IPI Academy
- [Bosnia & Herzegovina Futures Foundation](https://goatconf.com/supporter-bh-futures-foundation): Funding and organising the BH Professionals Meetup on Saturday 5 June
- [Meister](https://goatconf.com/supporter-meister): Christoph Lipautz's travel

## Events people add

- [BH Professionals Meetup](https://goatconf.com/event-bh-professionals-meetup): Meetup, 5 June 2027, 18:00 to 21:00, run by Bosnia & Herzegovina Futures Foundation
